verdict.rationale: Moss is a semantic search runtime and SaaS platform, so event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for it. However, the evidence never documents user-defined rules, triggers, or event-driven actions. Related behaviors such as cloud sync, zero-downtime hot-swaps and snapshot fallback are built-in system behaviors, not rules a user configures, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
